historicalEvidence.title: Minutes benchmark · five completed seasons
historicalEvidence.summary: 2021–22 through 2025–26; 30-team schedule reconciliation recorded. 171,428 rows: 159,613 valid labels and 11,815 unknown outcomes retained. On valid labels, boosting MAE 5.973 minutes / RMSE 8.713; rolling baseline MAE 6.711 / RMSE 9.593. Retrospective minutes research, not betting validation.

historicalEvidence.title: Missing outcomes and remaining checks
historicalEvidence.summary: Boosting minus rolling paired MAE: deterministic missing-label bounds [-0.942, -0.433] minutes. These are not confidence intervals. Remaining checks: historical pregame input provenance; corrected-history build lineage; saved chronological training cutoff receipts; sampling uncertainty; market-price validation and future paper record. Fixed retrospective predictions; deterministic missing-label bounds, not confidence intervals, future accuracy, betting profitability or deployed content. Frozen-output hashes were recorded now, not at original generation.
